function: p. 6-7: SAC agent outputs UAV motion, beam priority logits and a threshold that set active beams and the power split between sensing and user beams, minimizing AoI.
system: p. 3, 9: One UAV at 50 m with 4x4 UPA (2x2 to 6x6 tested) serves 6 single-antenna ground users and senses a target; 2 GHz; no RIS.
method: p. 6-9: Soft actor-critic deep reinforcement learning (off-policy, entropy-regularized), fully connected actor and twin critics trained from rewards; regularized zero-forcing and Kalman filter handle beam directions.
data_channel: p. 4, 9: Own simulator: free-space Friis line-of-sight channel with UPA steering vector, radar equation, random user layouts in a 1,600 m square, perturbed target path; no dataset.
test_conditions: p. 9-13: Trained 10,000 episodes of 60 slots; evaluated on 100 seeded layouts, sweeping SINR threshold, accuracy threshold, array size 2-6, users 3-15; one 300-slot test reuses policies.
baselines: p. 10: Non-learned: SAGS (AoI-greedy single-user scheduling), KF-RAND (random waypoint and logits). Learned: A2C and PPO with the same state, action and reward.
metrics: p. 10-12: Average AoI with 95% confidence intervals, training return, radar detection SNR, average user SINR.
complexity: p. 9: Training O(N F_env + (N J D / I_upd)(F_pi + 2 F_Q)) per episode; per-slot inference O(F_env) with RZF O(|U|^2 M + |U|^3).
q1_support: p. 4: "follows a free-space path loss model" (Friis line-of-sight channel with a UPA steering vector, own simulator); no 3GPP, ray-tracing or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 13: "reused without retraining" in a consecutive-mission test at the default K=6, 4x4 UPA and 10 dB settings; training curves are reported per configuration (Figs. 3-4, p. 10) and no passage tests a policy trained in one configuration on another.
q3_support: Non-learned: p. 10: "Single-User AoI-Greedy Scheduling (SAGS)"; learned: p. 10: "Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)" and A2C with the same state, action and reward; compared on average AoI (Figs. 5-6, p. 11).
q4_support: p. 9: "the total training complexity per episode is" O(N F_env + (N J D / I_upd)(F_pi + 2 F_Q)), and the per-slot inference complexity is O(F_env).
q5_support: p. 9: "user layouts using seeds ranging from 100 to 199"; the authors' own simulator is described only by seeds, with no link to code or data and no public dataset.
notes: Area 6 over 5 by the specificity order: UAV (aerial) link that also senses. Learned part sets UAV motion and the power split among sensing and user beams; beam directions come from RZF and Kalman filter, not learned. Trajectory and user scheduling are above PHY, but learned power allocation among beams in an aerial link is PHY, so above_phy does not apply. q2 borderline: only the 300-slot consecutive-mission test (p. 13) reuses policies without retraining, at default settings.
